newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Incentive to sell TA Hydronics to IMI.
newsitem.headline: Incentive to sell TA Hydronics to IMI.

text.p: Swedish investment and medical technology company Incentive AB said on Thursday that it was selling subsidiary TA Hydronics to Britain's IMI Plc for about 1.2 billion crowns.
The sale would give Incentive a capital gain of about 800 million crowns, the company said in a statement.
The sale is subject to the necessary regulatory approvals.
Incentive said TA Hydronics is one of the world's leading suppliers of products and systems for the HVAC sector.
The main products are valves and pipe couplings.
The company, with its head office at Ljung outside Boras in southern Sweden, is one of the biggest players on the Nordic market with annual turnover of about 850 million crowns and 850 employees.
Its operating profit in 1996 was about 120 million crowns.
"This is a further step in the strategic development of Incentive," managing director Mikael Lilius said in a statement.
"We are concentrating the company further on operations which can generate significant growth in value."
